title: A heartbeat Hackatime stored, as its heartbeat endpoints answer with it
description: HackatimeController#push_heartbeats answers a single POST with this body and 202, and each heartbeat of a bulk POST it took with [this body, 201] (hackatime_controller.rb lines 67-75, 227-228). It is the stored row's attributes, every column of the heartbeats table (HC 1.2), for a heartbeat inserted now and for one whose fields_hash a row already has, which gets that earlier row (heartbeat_ingest.rb lines 70-82; heartbeat.rb lines 41-56). Only the fields below are pinned: the four WakaTime gives in its own answer (HC 2.1). No client WP-AD16's capture saw reads this body. wakatime-cli v2.28.4 looks for data.id in it, which a row doesn't have, so it reads nothing (pkg/api/heartbeat.go).

time.description: Epoch seconds with fractions, after HeartbeatIngest moved a millisecond, microsecond, nanosecond or Windows-epoch time into seconds (heartbeat_ingest.rb lines 364-383).
